questions.q: Who co-wrote The Fifth Agreement with Don Miguel Ruiz?
a: His son, Don Jose Ruiz
His brother, Don Luis Ruiz
His editor, Don Carlos Ruiz
His student, Don Pedro Ruiz
questions.why: The overview says Ruiz wrote the sequel with his son, Don Jose Ruiz, in 2009.

questions.q: What is the fifth agreement the book adds to the original four?
a: Be skeptical, but learn to listen
Always keep your word, whatever it costs
Take every comment personally and respond
Make assumptions only when they help you
questions.why: The overview lists the new principle as being skeptical while still learning to listen.

questions.q: According to lesson 1, what happens as children are introduced to symbology?
a: They absorb culturally biased values and norms
They lose the ability to use language
They stop copying their parents entirely
They naturally reject every social rule
questions.why: Lesson 1 says symbols carry cultural values and norms, so growing up conditions us.

questions.q: Why does lesson 2 conclude that everything we know is only relatively true?
a: Knowledge needs shared symbols that people must agree on
Facts change completely from one day to the next
Only scientists are able to describe reality
Language slowly destroys the things it names
questions.why: Lesson 2 argues symbols require agreement between people, so knowledge is relative.

questions.q: In lesson 3, how should you handle someone insulting or labeling you?
a: Treat their words as their truth, not yours
Repeat the insult back to them immediately
Accept it as an objective fact about you
Stop speaking to that person for good
questions.why: Lesson 3 advises seeing others' words as symbols and relative truths you can decline.
